payload.title: Home server install behind a TLS proxy (ADR 0008)
payload.context: Phase 1 runs on a home server reachable only over Tailscale. The development stack is not suitable for a server and the app built http links behind tailscale serve. See docs/adr/0008-home-server-install.md.
payload.rationale: Production image from docker-compose.yml alone, web port bound to 127.0.0.1, HTTPS terminated by tailscale serve, and NOONGUN_TRUSTED_PROXIES naming trusted proxies with a default of none.
payload.consequences: Server install is a manual sequence in the README. Instances sharing a host need their own port, project name and session cookie name. Backups belong to M7.
